comment: Variation of portal-nowhere-hero-escape: an improvised tune before #wizloadlua tut-1 changes where the hero goes. music.c improvised_notes() leaves svc.context.jingle as one note, 'G', here; svd.dungeons[-1] overlays svc.context, so when the hero enters the tutorial's portal to {-1,-1}, ledger_no() reads ledger_start = 'G' (71) and gives 70 rather than escaping. goto_level() moves the hero to Dlvl -2 of dungeon -1: builds_up() and the portal search each call impossible(), and mklev() builds a plain level. ^O then runs dungeon.c #overview with the hero in dungeon -1, whose empty dname prints no dungeon header above 'Level -2'. Same seed and character as the escape case; the inputs differ only by the flute and the overview.
